scope: DXF POINTPATH and OBJECTPTR object record identity remapping and binding.

source_context.schema: DXF group 5 is the object's own record identity. POINTPATH's coordinate body and OBJECTPTR's empty type-specific body do not replace that common identity.
source_context.implementation_gap: dxfRW::writePointPath and dxfRW::writeObjectPtr wrote the source identity directly, omitted explicit handle reservation and did not bind source object handles to emitted records.

implementation.behavior: Each supplied source identity is remapped, validated against invalid/fixed output handles, reserved, written as group 5, then source-bound after serialization. A zero/no-source identity is allocated. RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope make identity publication and record bytes transactional.
implementation.reference_policy: The common owner remains a separately serialized owner reference; POINTPATH coordinates and OBJECTPTR body remain unchanged.
implementation.failure_behavior: Common metadata, owner, body or EED write failures leave the staged record unpublished and scoped object identity state rolled back.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: POINTPATH group-5 identity remaps while preserving its coordinate body
OBJECTPTR group-5 identity remaps while retaining its empty type-specific body
both outputs are read back in the scene-object identity matrix with resolver enabled and disabled
late invalid EED rolls back existing destination bytes and does not publish identity bindings
corrected fresh-writer retries read back and bind the remapped identities
existing typed common-metadata controls remain passing

qualification_limits: Generated controls do not establish physical producer coverage or native object semantics.
This transport fix does not promote POINTPATH or OBJECTPTR support claims.
